us.h: Senate Democrats weigh tying shutdown deadline to Iran war cutoff
us.s: Several Senate Democrats say they'll oppose any stopgap spending bill by the Dec. 11 deadline unless it bars funds for the Iran war, raising odds of a holiday partial shutdown; GOP leaders reject the idea.

us.h: Cancer society now urges routine prostate screening for midlife men
us.s: The American Cancer Society reversed its 2010 stance, recommending PSA tests every two years for average-risk men aged 50–69 and yearly from 45 for Black men and those with strong family history.

us.h: Democrat Holscher projected winner of Kansas governor race
us.s: After days of counting mail and provisional ballots, Democrat Cindy Holscher is projected to beat GOP Senate President Ty Masterson, extending Democratic control of the governorship; Republicans lose their veto-proof House supermajority.

us.h: Alaska Democrats edge ahead in governor and Senate counts
us.s: Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins narrowly passed 50% in the governor's race, enough to avoid ranked-choice tabulation if it holds, while Mary Peltola leads Sen. Dan Sullivan by about 5,800 votes; final ballots are counted Nov. 18.

us.h: Senators probe whether RFK Jr. misled Congress on Samoa trip
us.s: Sens. Wyden and Alsobrooks demanded documents from Children's Health Defense after a letter surfaced showing Kennedy's 2019 Samoa visit referenced vaccines repeatedly, contradicting his confirmation testimony. HHS calls the accusation defamatory.

us.h: Texas and Oklahoma carry out executions on same day
us.s: Texas executed John Allen Rubio for killing three children in 2003, hours after Oklahoma executed James Pavatt, bringing U.S. executions this year to 37.

world.h: Trump drops Vance from Iran talks, says no deal needed
world.s: Trump said the US doesn't need an agreement with Iran and reassigned Vance away from diplomacy to domestic fraud probes, while keeping the blockade of Iranian ports and sanctions in place.

world.h: Iran says LNG tanker struck mine in Strait of Hormuz
world.s: Iran's Revolutionary Guards navy said a gas tanker hit a mine Friday after four oil tankers were hit by blasts Thursday, as attacks on shipping persist despite hopes of de-escalation.

world.h: Europe to get seat at next Ukraine peace talks
world.s: After meeting Putin in Moscow, US envoys Kushner and Witkoff told Zelenskyy in Dublin that EU delegates will join the next round; Putin still rejects European troops in Ukraine and holds territorial demands.

world.h: Iran refuses nuclear monitoring talks while under threat
world.s: A confidential IAEA report says Tehran won't discuss resuming inspections amid US military threats, leaving the agency unable to verify Iran's near-weapons-grade uranium stockpile.

world.h: Finland detects strike on Russian warship near its waters
world.s: Finland's military reported a strike on a small Russian navy vessel in the Gulf of Finland, reportedly claimed by Ukraine, but said Finland faces no immediate threat.

world.h: North Korea reshapes its flag for first time since 1948
world.s: A revised constitution makes the flag narrower while keeping its colors and star, a move analysts tie to Kim Jong Un's push for a separate national identity from South Korea.

tech.h: Microsoft email outage stretches into a second day
tech.s: A global Exchange Online failure that began Thursday still disrupts Outlook, calendars and Copilot for many users. Microsoft reports gradual recovery, rules out a hack, and has extended email timeouts to 48 hours.

tech.h: Nonprofits sue AI giants to halt frontier model work
tech.s: Public Citizen and other groups sued OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and SpaceX's AI unit in San Francisco. They want a court order stopping development of more advanced models, citing unfair-business and public-nuisance laws.

tech.h: Google rolls out faster Gemini 4 Hydrogen model
tech.s: Google's new everyday model is rolling out globally in the Gemini app, Search and its developer tools. Free app users get it automatically, and API prices are higher than the Flash model it succeeds.

tech.h: SpaceX plans $74 billion AI computing campuses
tech.s: SpaceX will spend more than $74 billion on supercomputing sites at Starbase, Texas, and in Cochise County, Arizona. The Arizona project still needs county approval and faces a resident petition opposing it.

tech.h: Notion AI chats exposed in Fireworks AI breach
tech.s: Hackers who breached AI host Fireworks reached Notion AI chat transcripts from under 1% of workspaces. Notion tells affected customers to rotate any passwords or keys they pasted into Notion AI.

talking.h: NBC golf and Olympics voice Dan Hicks dies at 64
talking.s: Dan Hicks, NBC Sports' lead golf announcer who called 27 Tiger Woods wins and Olympic swimming, died of an acute illness, his wife Hannah Storm said.

talking.h: Record-setting liner SS United States sunk as giant reef
talking.s: The 1950s ocean liner, which still holds the transatlantic speed record, was scuttled off Destin, Florida, to become what officials call the world's largest artificial reef.

coming.s: The Census Bureau publishes October advance retail sales at 8:30 a.m. ET, a key read on consumer spending heading into the holidays.

coming.h: Nvidia reports earnings, its first without Huang
coming.s: Nvidia still plans to report third-quarter results Tuesday and hold its call at 2 p.m. PT. It's interim CEO Colette Kress's first report since Jensen Huang resigned.
Minutes from the Fed's Oct. 27–28 policy meeting come out at 2 p.m. ET and could hint at the path for interest rates.

coming.h: Alaska finishes ballot count in tight races
coming.s: Alaska's final ballot count is due Nov. 18, settling the close governor and Senate races and any ranked-choice tabulations.
